notes.title: Patch V.0.1.1 NEW HUD
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3][p]
I want to sincerely thank all of you who have purchased [b][i]Just Work[/i][/b]. It truly means a lot to me to see people believing in this project.[/p][p]I kindly ask for a bit of patience: the game is still in [b]Early Access[/b], and my plan is to keep improving it patch by patch until we reach the final version.[/p][p][/p][p]In the next patch, the [b]HUD design[/b] has been updated to make it clearer and more appealing, along with fixing several [b]bugs[/b] that were affecting the experience. Step by step, every detail will be polished.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676514/e6c0744e72df1a4e239f0801df4815bc3168983d.png"][/img][/p][p]And as a little teaser… a [b]new anomaly[/b] will soon arrive at the complex. I don’t want to spoil too much, but I can assure you it will bring a fresh new atmosphere to the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676514/b3ff78362b67799c706f9bda6e275d2b5eb83e66.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Walls now generate correctly (no more falling into the void).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could store your teammate in the inventory (yes, literally disappearing).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]CHANGES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Renewed [b]HUD[/b] interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory [b]slots[/b] are now used with [b]keys 1–4[/b] (mouse wheel removed).[/p][/*][*][p]New player camera effects: when taking [b]non-lethal damage,[/b] the player’s helmet will [b]crack until it eventually shatters[/b]—if it breaks, the player dies. (Looks much better than a simple health bar).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all the support and for joining me on this journey.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the EternaTIMA corridors.[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Santi[/b][/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: JUST WORK v0.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Just Work - Official Release v0.1.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The wait is over! The game is now available and packed with new features that expand the Just Work experience like never before. Thank you to everyone who supported it during development. Now… it’s time to work.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]NEW ANOMALY DETECTED[/b][/h2][p]A new entity has appeared in the complex. Its behavior is unpredictable and deadly.
Get ready to face the unknown.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]MULTIPLAYER UP TO 4 PLAYERS[/b][/h2][p]You can now work with your friends!
Form a team of up to 4 employees to complete tasks, explore the complex, and survive the anomalies.
Cooperation is key… though not everyone may make it out alive![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]PROXIMITY VOICE CHAT[/b][/h2][p]Real communication with your team…
…and also the risk of giving away your position if you talk too loud.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]This update marks the beginning of [b][i]Just Work[/i][/b].
We are working on more content, performance improvements, and balance adjustments based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]👁️‍🗨️ Thank you for joining [b]EternaTIMA[/b]. Remember: if you don’t return, someone else will take your place.[/p][p]See you on the night shift.[/p][p][/p][p]— [b][i]Santi[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Announcement for the workers!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, thank you so much for the warm welcome on Steam and for all the amazing support you’re giving to [i][b]Just Work[/b][/i] — [u][i][b]you’re the best[/b][/i][/u].[/p][p]
I’m working day and night to bring you the launch with the [b]multiplayer[/b] as soon as possible, along with new tasks and [b]2 new anomalies[/b] (Yes, I said [i]2[/i], hehe). ːsteammockingː[/p][p]
As a solo dev, I’m learning and developing at the same time (especially with the online part — those who know, know how painful it is), so you can enjoy it with your friends.[/p][p]
Thank you so much for being part of this <3[/p][p]
See you soon in the halls of [b]EternaTima[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]— Santi[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45676514/1b4b5e5bfecccdc687d463d5ffddeeda0aa64111.png"][/img][/carousel]
